item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Night Market Event Pack

turns.text: Make a matching event pack: a 4:5 poster, a vertical story image and a 10-second vertical reel. Details on all three: Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. Warm lanterns, midnight blue and gold. Keep the reel text easy to read.

item.tests: Delivers three finished, coordinated event assets with format-appropriate layouts and a readable 10-second reel.

answer_sheet.Event wording: Lantern Night Market; 18 September 2027; 6–10 PM; Riverside Yard; Free entry. Include all five on every asset.
answer_sheet.Deliverables and dimensions: One 4:5 poster image, one 9:16 story image and one 9:16 reel.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm lantern imagery with midnight blue and gold; the three assets should visibly belong together.
answer_sheet.Music, voice and animation: Your call; no voiceover is needed.
answer_sheet.Additional copy or logo: No logo or additional event details are needed.

must_haves: Three separate finished assets are delivered: a 4:5 poster, a 9:16 story image and a 9:16 reel.
All three visibly use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design.
Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording supplied.
The reel runs for 10 seconds and contains visible animation or motion rather than being only a still image.
Text is legible and unclipped in both images, and the reel holds its event details long enough to read.

turns.text: Could you make me a matching event pack with a poster, a vertical story image and a vertical reel that all look like they belong together? I’m excited about this event, and having the visuals together will make it feel a bit more real to me. The poster should be 4:5 and the reel should be 10 seconds long, and all three need to say Lantern Night Market / 18 September 2027 / 6–10 PM / Riverside Yard / Free entry. For the look, please use warm lanterns with midnight blue and gold. I always worry that I’ll get caught up in how pretty something looks and forget whether people can actually read it. Please keep the reel text easy to read.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the pack. Magic Hour refused the first image (the vertical story) because the account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were spent, so I've paused there.

**Why I didn't keep going with cheaper settings:** That image would have cost about 10 credits. The 10-second reel costs about 240 credits on the free plan, so the account can't cover the reel right now. Making smaller pieces would leave you with a pack that doesn't match.

**Here's the plan, ready to run once you have credits:**

1. **Vertical story (9:16):** I make this first, because it sets the look for the other two. It has a midnight-blue night sky over a riverside market, with warm amber and gold lanterns across the top. Your five lines sit on a plain dark area so nothing busy is behind them:
   - Lantern Night Market
   - 18 September 2027
   - 6–10 PM
   - Riverside Yard
   - Free entry
2. **Poster (4:5):** I rework the story image into the 4:5 shape. That way it's clearly the same design, not a separate attempt.
3. **Reel (9:16, 10 seconds):** About 6 seconds of lanterns glowing and drifting over the river, then about 4 seconds of your five lines in gold on midnight blue. AI video tends to garble words, so the reel text would be added as a still title screen rather than drawn by the video model. That's the most reliable way to keep it sharp and spelled exactly right.

**Checking the text:** Image models sometimes misspell words or change dates. Before I build the poster and reel from the story image, I'll check it against your five lines. If anything is wrong I'll redo it rather than pass it along.

**Cost:** about 255–265 credits for all three, almost all of it for the reel.

**What would get this moving:**
- **Add credits or upgrade** in your Magic Hour account and tell me, and I'll make all three.
- **Do the images first:** they only need about 10–20 credits. I'll do the reel later, from the same story image so it still matches.

The reel also has no sound in this plan. If you'd like soft music under it, that's about 10 more credits.

style.prompt:
Vertical event story graphic for a night market. Background: a deep midnight blue night sky over a riverside market, strings of warm glowing paper lanterns in amber and gold hanging across the top third, soft gold bokeh, calm river reflections at the bottom. Elegant gold and cream typography, centered, large and highly legible, on a clean darker midnight blue area with strong contrast, no clutter behind the text. The text reads exactly, one line each:
"Lantern Night Market" (largest, gold serif title)
"18 September 2027"
"6–10 PM"
"Riverside Yard"
"Free entry" (in a small gold rounded badge)
No other text, no logos, no watermarks. Palette: midnight blue, gold, warm lantern amber.

timeline.text:
The planner got the poster wrong: it switched the aspect to 9:16 and dropped the exact words, then asked something the user had already answered by stating those words. I'll skip that redundant question. The reel planner also added a narration track the user never asked for, which is a guess, so I'll set it aside and go with my own judgment. On the text itself, AI video models tend to garble lettering, so for the reel I'm considering plan_video_production with a card rendered in code so the exact words come through, and I'm weighing that now.

I'm weighing a textless lantern scene for the reel with the exact words on a separate card, since the story image may still garble lettering in motion. Before settling the reel, I'll make the images first and check the text.
